description: Opens Settings on Home layout (debug OPEN_SETTINGS, never a remembered page), sets Style to Minimal, audits the home screen, then sets Single row again.

steps.note: HOME, then Settings opened on Home layout (debug OPEN_SETTINGS): a known page
into the page: focus on the first row, Layout style
opens Layout style; focus on its first row, Style
Style stepped down to Single row; the extra LEFT moves focus to the sidebar (LEFT at a page edge), so the start is always the same
first RIGHT brings focus back to the Style row (Single row), then one step per style: the style under test
home relays itself out (200 ms fade)
HOME, then Settings opened on Home layout (debug OPEN_SETTINGS): a known page
into the page: focus on the first row, Layout style
opens Layout style; focus on its first row, Style
restore: Style stepped down to Single row; the extra LEFT moves focus to the sidebar (LEFT at a page edge), so the start is always the same
home relays itself out as Single row
